slides.title: 5 signs your AI reply isn't **ready to send**.
slides.sub: One quick read-through catches all five. Here's what to look for, on a real draft.

messages.text: Reply to this complaint: "My order arrived 5 days late and nobody answered my emails."

Dear [Customer Name],
Thank you for reaching out, and I'm truly sorry for the delay with your order and the lack of response to your emails.
We're looking into what happened and will make sure this doesn't happen again. As a token of our apology, we'd like to offer you [discount/refund].

steps.t: A bracket is still in it
It promises what you didn't decide
steps.d: "This won't happen again." Can you guarantee that?

steps.t: It states facts you never gave it
steps.d: "We're looking into what happened." Are you?

slides.title: The two that are easy to miss

steps.d: No name, no order number, no date. It reads like a template because it is one.
Refunds, legal threats, an upset regular. Write the last version yourself.

cards.title: Rewrite with real facts
cards.text: Rewrite this reply. Use only these facts: [WHAT HAPPENED, WHAT I'VE DONE, WHAT I'LL DO]. No promises beyond those. Use their name and order number. Under 80 words. Draft: [PASTE]

slides.note: Remove addresses and payment details before pasting.

before.label: VAGUE DRAFT
before.text: ...We're looking into what happened and will make sure this doesn't happen again. As a token of our apology, we'd like to offer you [discount/refund].

after.label: WITH REAL FACTS
after.text:
Hi Jordan, I'm sorry order #4127 reached you 5 days late, and that your emails went unanswered. The courier held it at their depot for 4 days, and nobody checked our inbox while I was away. That's on me.
I've refunded your shipping today. If anything's wrong with the order, reply here and I'll answer the same day.

slides.note: Facts given: courier delay, inbox unchecked, shipping refunded, same-day replies.

slides.title: Before you hit **send**
items: Every fact is one you gave it
Their name and details are in it

caption:
5 signs an AI-written reply needs a human before you send it

I asked for a reply to a complaint with a vague prompt. The draft sounded fine, until I read it properly:

1) A bracket was still in it: [Customer Name].
2) It promised "this won't happen again" and a refund nobody had decided on.
3) It said "we're looking into what happened". Nobody was.
4) No name, no order number: it could have gone to anyone.
5) Late order plus ignored emails: high stakes, so a human writes the last version.

The fix is one more prompt with the real facts:

"Rewrite this reply. Use only these facts: [WHAT HAPPENED, WHAT I'VE DONE, WHAT I'LL DO]. No promises beyond those. Use their name and order number. Under 80 words. Draft: [PASTE]"

Follow @nomorebusywork and comment PACK: I'll DM you 21 more prompts.

Save this for later. 📌
